text: Could you make me an illustration that feels quiet and a little hopeful? I've been wanting something like that because a small bit of hope feels especially welcome to me right now. As far as what it actually shows, you can pick the scene, and I don't have a particular illustration style in mind either, so that's your call too. I do want no words in it. I'm probably over-explaining because I worry I'm not describing the feeling very well, even though I really do want to leave the choices to you.
